snippet.title: Otterly Lost | Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi there! We're very excited to share that the demo is finally live 🦦💙

It's been such a journey getting here. Please feel free to share your thoughts, any issues you run into, or just moments that made you smile. Your feedback helps us make it better as we keep developing the full game. 🌊🐾

If it's something you find interesting, you can play it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4079110 

We'd love to hear what you think!
